disposition_reason: The paper states only that metal levels in all raw milk samples were below or close to the LOQs; no concentrations, counts above LOQ or summary statistics are printed for any metal.

study.design: Multi-year official monitoring of raw bovine milk for metals, PCBs and pesticides
study.origin: 75 cattle farms supplying the Turin central dairy, Province of Turin, Italy
study.market: raw milk sampled weekly at farm/dairy intake
study.method: Microwave pressure digestion (HNO3 + H2O2) of 2 g; Zeeman GFAAS for As, Cd, Cr, Pb; flame AAS for Fe; direct mercury analyzer (TDA-AAS, EPA 7473) for Hg
study.qa: Calibration against standard solutions; UNI EN 13805 and 14083 methods; no CRM results printed

unresolved: Metal results are qualitative only ("below or close to the LOQ"); because some values were near rather than below the LOQ, they cannot be recorded as censored non-detects.
The English summary says 252 samples and lists Cd, Cr, Fe, Hg, Pb, Zn, while the methods give 202 samples (51+50+51+50) for As, Cd, Cr, Fe, Hg, Pb; zinc has no method described.
No DOI is printed in the PDF; manifest DOI 10.4081/ijfs.2009.6.48 used. Manifest note "As not measured" is contradicted by the methods, which include arsenic.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU Regulation 333/2007 sampling and analysis methods; EU lead limit said to be widely respected
